fishing: WHEN: Thu Nov 5; winds easing, sheltered Lemon Bay / inshore best. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, whiting, pompano, sheepshead, flounder, Spanish mackerel near Englewood Beach / Manasota / Stump Pass on live shrimp, paddletails, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish, snook, trout, flounder, sheepshead on docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats (Chadwick). NEARSHORE: limited by residual wind; cobia/snapper/kings when calm. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: Waterline Nov 5 (Fishin Franks/Economy Tackle/Capt Roger: Lemon Bay reds/snook/trout/flounder strong), FL Sportsman SW recent patterns, Capt. Mike Manasota Key Outfitters.
redtide: FWC Oct 30 status: K. brevis not observed in Southwest Florida past week. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay/Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota. Next report Nov 6.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key / Palm Island GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples Oct 5-12). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~148-149 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
